residency.note: NYUAD requires residence in Abu Dhabi for the final semester of enrollment (in absentia completion considered only within 8 credits of graduation); there is no fixed final-credits-in-residence count. minCredits (half of the 128-credit degree) and majorMinorResidencyPercent are inferred CAS-style defaults — the bulletin states a final-semester residency rule, not a credit-count or per-major/minor percentage.

creditCaps.label: Post-matriculation transfer credit (max 8/semester on leave, 8/summer, 20 career)
Online course credits (inferred CAS default; NYUAD bulletin silent)

exceptions: Available only beginning in the second year of study
Electives only — major, minor, and Core courses (incl. E, Q, X, J, Colloquium) cannot be taken P/F
First attempt in any Core area must be letter-graded
A P/F course cannot satisfy a prerequisite
J-Term and summer courses may not be taken P/F

doubleCounting.note: NYUAD double-counting is governed by uniqueness floors, not a fixed double-count count: each of two majors must include >=30 credits not counted toward the other major, and each minor must include >=2 courses not counted toward any other major or minor. No individual course may count for more than one Core category, and Art/Design/Technology, Cultural Exploration & Analysis, Data & Discovery, and Structures of Thought & Society Core courses may not simultaneously count toward a major or minor (Islamic Studies, Quantitative Reasoning, and Experimental Inquiry may). Colloquia cannot be double counted. The numeric default* fields are inferred placeholders pending per-program modeling.

transferCreditLimits.note: Transfer credit is awarded only for coursework taken AFTER matriculation at NYUAD; no transfer credit for pre-matriculation or high-school work, and none for AP/IB/A-Level exams. Up to 8 credits per semester while on approved leave and up to 8 credits per summer, to a career total of no more than 20. firstYearMaxTotal=0 reflects the no-pre-matriculation rule (inferred framing of the CAS first-year field).

overloadRequirements.note: First-year students (from their second semester) need a cumulative internal GPA >= 3.7 to overload above 18 credits
Second-year students need a cumulative internal GPA >= 3.6 to overload
Third- and fourth-year students need a cumulative internal GPA >= 3.5 to overload; no student may exceed 20 credit hours, and overloads are not possible in J-Terms or summer sessions

deansListThreshold.note: INFERRED — NYUAD does not publish a Dean's List; it recognizes Latin Honors by graduating-cohort percentile (summa top 5%, magna next 10%, cum laude next 15% per division). This CAS-default 3.65 is a placeholder and not an NYUAD-stated threshold.
